column1: # Köməkçi fast commands, English. Understood on the phone, without the AI server.
# One command per line:   category | INTENT | pattern
#   {contact}  a person (family list, then the phone's contacts)    {text}      free text
#   {time}     a clock time: 7, 7:30, 7 pm, half past seven, noon   {duration}  10 minutes, an hour
#   {app}      an app name: whatsapp, youtube, gallery, maps...     {service}   ambulance, police, fire, emergency
#   (a/b) one of the words is required     [a/b] optional
# "tomorrow" and "every day" may be said anywhere in an alarm command. Lines are tried top to bottom.
safety | HELP_ME | i (fell/fell down/have fallen/am hurt)
calls | CALL | make a call to {contact}
messages | READ_MESSAGES | (do i have/are there/any) [new] messages
time and phone | TIME | what time is it [now]
time and phone | TIME | what is the time [now]
time and phone | TIME | tell me the time
time and phone | DATE | what is (the date/todays date) [today]
time and phone | DATE | what (day/date) is (it/today) [today]
time and phone | DATE | what is today
time and phone | DATE | which day is (it/today)
time and phone | BATTERY | how much battery [do i have/is left/left]
time and phone | BATTERY | (what is/check) my battery [level]
time and phone | BATTERY | is (my phone/the phone/it) charging
time and phone | INTERNET | am i (online/connected) [to the internet]
sound and light | VOLUME_UP | (turn/make) [it/the volume/the sound] louder
sound and light | VOLUME_UP | turn up the (volume/sound)
sound and light | VOLUME_UP | i (cannot/can not) hear [you]
sound and light | VOLUME_DOWN | (turn/make) [it/the volume/the sound] quieter
sound and light | VOLUME_DOWN | turn down the (volume/sound)
sound and light | VOLUME_DOWN | (it is too loud/too loud)
sound and light | MUTE | turn off the sound
sound and light | SOUND_ON | (unmute/sound on) [the phone]
sound and light | SOUND_ON | turn on the sound
sound and light | FLASHLIGHT_ON | i need [some] light
sound and light | BRIGHTNESS | make the screen (brighter/darker)
sound and light | WIFI | (open/show/turn on/turn off/connect to) [the] wifi [settings]
sound and light | BLUETOOTH | (open/show/turn on/turn off) [the] bluetooth [settings]
alarms | MEDICINE_REMIND | remind me to take my (medicine/pills/tablets/medication) at {time}
alarms | REMIND_AT | remind me to {text} at {time}
alarms | REMIND_AT | remind me at {time} to {text}
alarms | REMIND_IN | remind me to {text} in {duration}
alarms | REMIND_IN | remind me in {duration} to {text}
alarms | LIST_ALARMS | (what/which) alarms (do i have/are set/have i got)
alarms | CANCEL_ALARMS | (delete/cancel/remove/clear/turn off) (all my alarms/all alarms/my alarms/the alarms)
health | MEDICINE_TAKEN | i (took/have taken/had/just took) my (medicine/pills/tablets/medication)
health | MEDICINE_CHECK | did i take my (medicine/pills/tablets/medication) [today]
health | MEDICINE_CHECK | (when did i take/have i taken) my (medicine/pills/tablets/medication) [today]
reading | READ_SCREEN | what is on [the/my] screen
reading | READ_SCREEN | read this (page/message) [to me/for me]
reading | CAMERA | read this [to me/for me]
assistant | REPEAT | (repeat/repeat that/say it again/say that again/again/what did you say/pardon/sorry)
assistant | SLOWER | (slow down/too fast/you speak too fast)
assistant | THANKS | (thank you/thanks/thanks a lot/thank you very much)
assistant | NAME | (what is your name/who are you)
assistant | HELP | (what can you do/how do i use you/what do you do)
